ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.1.0 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Living World Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/archdukejim/rimworld-living-world/wiki
Brings inhabited maps to life. Where other mods count how many people a place should hold, Living World is what actually puts them there: homesteads and dwellings with residents who farm, cook, self-tend, forage in winter, and trade their surplus to passing traders — so the settlers you find on a map plausibly survived long enough to have built it.
--- What it does --- - Homestead generation: dwellings, fields and residents placed at map generation. - Self-sufficient residents: a caretaker keeps them alive - they tend their own wounds, cook to keep a small stock of meals, harvest their crops, and forage wild plants in winter. - Starting supplies: each resident spawns with medicine, meals and a modest non-explosive self-defence weapon. - Harvest brings a trader: harvesting a crop draws a passing trader who buys the surplus and leaves preserved food and supplies behind.
All counts and thresholds are tunable in the mod settings.
--- Standalone, and better together --- Living World requires neither Regions and Territories nor Map Mode Framework, and holds no hard reference to any other mod.
- With RimSynapse - Regions and Territories: it reads that mod's regional population model to decide where and how densely to place inhabitants. - On its own: it seeds a modest number of homesteads on habitable tiles from the world seed. - With RimSynapse - Core: residency is shared so Conversations and Psychology can tell a resident from a passer-by. - With Combat Extended: residents are given the correct ammunition for their weapon.
Each of these is optional. Every cross-mod link is soft, so nothing is required and nothing breaks when a partner mod is absent.
--- Roadmap --- Deeper Regions and Territories integration (region-aware homestead makeup), more resident livelihoods, and richer trader behaviour. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.1.0) - Initial release --- - First release. Extracted from RimSynapse - Regions and Territories as a standalone companion mod: the living-pawn layer (homesteads, residents, self-sufficiency and the harvest-trader loop) is now its own mod, so Regions and Territories can stay a pure map and territory model. - Standalone: works with or without Regions and Territories and Map Mode Framework. - Combat Extended and RimSynapse Core are supported through soft, optional hooks.
Full version history: https://github.com/archdukejim/rimworld-living-world/wiki/Changelog
